name="psblas"
version="0.0.0"
license="BSD-3-Clause"
[library]
source-dir="playground-library"
include-dir=["base/auxil", "base/comm", "base/comm/internals", "base/modules", "base/modules/auxil", "base/modules/comm", "base/modules/desc", "base/modules/penv", "base/modules/psblas", "base/modules/serial", "base/modules/tools", "base/psblas", "base/serial", "base/serial/impl", "base/serial/sort", "base/tools", "linsolve", "linsolve/impl", "playground-generated", "prec", "prec/impl"]
[build]
auto-executables=false
auto-examples=false
auto-tests=false
external-modules=["mpi","mpi_f08","omp_lib"]
link=["mpichfort","mpich","openblas"]
[fortran]
implicit-typing=true
implicit-external=true
[install]
library=true
